SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_RELIC_BOX_LUNCH.title: Box Lunch
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_RELIC_BOX_LUNCH.descrip: The first time one of your [gold]Scripts[/gold] ends each turn, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}. At the start of each combat, gain [gold]Script: Sentry[/gold].
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_RELIC_BOX_LUNCH.flavor: No box lunch, what to eat?
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_RELIC_ABUNDANT_BOX_LUNC:
The first three times a [gold]Script[/gold] ends each turn, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
At the start of each combat, gain [gold]Script: Vice General[/gold].
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_RELIC_MENGDE_NEW_BOOK.d:
For each [gold]Buff[/gold] an enemy has, damage dealt to you is reduced by [blue]8%[/blue], up to [blue]40%[/blue].
For each [gold]Debuff[/gold] you have, damage you deal is increased by [blue]8%[/blue], up to [blue]40%[/blue].
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_RELIC_MENGDE_NEW_BOOK.f: Military treatises only make fools. Learn war from this.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_RELIC_ADVANCED_GUNPOWDE:
At the start of your turn, gain [blue]{TinderPower}[/blue] [gold]Tinder[/gold].
Whenever you apply [gold]Burning[/gold], reduce its extinguish chance to [blue]0%[/blue] instead of [blue]25%[/blue].
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_RELIC_ZHU_DICTIONARY.de:
Whenever you obtain a [gold]Script[/gold] card, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it.
At the start of each combat, add a random [gold]Upgraded[/gold] [gold]Script[/gold] card to your hand.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_RELIC_ZHU_DICTIONARY.fl: Master this book, and you're a rhetorician too.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_RELIC_TELEPROMPTER.flav: It'd be more useful with pinyin.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_RELIC_SUPPORTING_ACTOR_:
After combats from the strong monster pool, gain a [gold]Relic[/gold] as if from an Elite.
After the second-to-last Boss combat in Act 3, gain an [gold]Upgraded[/gold] [gold]Rare[/gold] card reward.
The name field has been deliberately smudged—illegible…
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_RELIC_DAILY_WAGE.title: Daily Wage
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_RELIC_DAILY_WAGE.descri: At the end of your turn, if you played a [gold]Script[/gold] card this turn, gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_RELIC_LUBU_BASKETBALL.f: Among men, Lubu. Among balls, MVP.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_RELIC_REUSED_PROPS.desc: When obtained, choose an [gold]Exhaust[/gold] [gold]Script[/gold] card in your deck. It loses [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_RELIC_REUSED_PROPS.flav: Use it again. No one will notice…
